evidence_summary: Prior local contract gate recorded 134 Protocol tests plus 31 rich-profile cases; ARM64 current-profile fixture recorded 24/24.
The independently accepted native developer-bundle foundation remains bounded source/package evidence; it does not by itself close F3 or F6.

G3 accepted the exact product 2026.36.2 bindings from final G2/G4, G5 and G6 evidence: hub-http-v1@1.0.0 remains b80d940e...d926 across Protocol, TypeScript and Swift while Edge retains edge-delivery-v2@2.0.0 e304fb6e...d224.

All five compatibility records passed the scoped G3 admission/readback checker; its 6 focused cases prove active-only operation, idempotence and fail-closed identity/divergence handling without reading Viewer. The TypeScript vendored Protocol copy is byte-identical and its focused lock/readback check passes.
The repaired checker is bound by r2 receipt SHA-256 5df27073463ca985f409332a043b5f46aa753ba4b1b65fe214bc434521ef1865.

A deterministic 172-member developer archive now closes 170 public source payload members plus its canonical manifest and checksum map; two post-review builds were byte-identical at SHA-256 6368e2f59303b8ed7623c7817492269fc869e77754909ab47bd4cc6aefb196ec.

A verified clean extraction on macOS 27 arm64 used Python 3.11.16 and uv 0.12.12: a fresh locked install seeded an isolated cache, then a deleted environment reinstalled with UV_OFFLINE=1 and passed 142 tests plus 31 rich-profile conformance runs.

The first independent review requested four verifier corrections. The frozen delta now rejects raw or concatenated gzip tails, decoded post-tar bytes, renamed extraction roots before destination creation, unknown/mutated/reordered manifest data, and setuid/setgid/sticky modes.

Archive verification also continues to fail closed on links, traversal, duplicate members, parent/file conflicts, non-canonical metadata or order, extra/missing members, changed modes, content divergence and dependency-lock divergence.

Independent Sol/high recheck returned ACCEPT after reproducing the final archive identity/counts, all eight focused regressions, the 142-test native gate and 31/31 conformance runs; the acceptance is explicitly bounded to the native bundle foundation.

The exact published commit 6686615c...a970 and archive 6368e2f5...96ec were reproduced in the native Debian 13 ARM64 guest, but the published Docker image collected 142 tests and ended with six errors because required bundle inputs were absent from the final image.

A minimal Dockerfile candidate now copies docs/, Dockerfile and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Its deterministic archive is 8ac5ccfa...b8be and its native linux/arm64 image dc170e65...ece91 passed 142/142 tests plus 31/31 conformance as UID/GID 10001 with UV_OFFLINE=1 and --network none.
Independent Sol/high review returned ACCEPT with no findings for the bounded dirty-tree ARM64 Docker candidate and its calibrated receipt; this does not make the candidate reachable-source evidence.

The published runtime-source commit 53b5c648...d87b1b was staged only through its clean git archive. Two ARM64 guest builds reproduced bundle 8ac5ccfa...b8be and the digest-pinned native image 721f2ad8...58095 passed 142/142 tests plus 31/31 conformance as UID/GID 10001 with UV_OFFLINE=1 and --network none.

Independent Sol/high review returned ACCEPT with no findings for the exact published runtime-source 53b5c648...d87b1b native ARM64 Docker developer-bundle slice and its corrected r2 evidence chronology; the later evidence commit does not replace that runtime-source identity.
The guest returned to zero Docker images/containers/volumes/cache, its temporary context was removed, it was stopped, port 60022 closed and the heavy-build lock was released.
